mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code_snippet (user_id, title, content, language, tags, use_count, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{language}, #{tags}, #{useCount}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE code_snippet SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, language = #{language}, tags = #{tags}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM code_snippet WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
